authority.rule: Drive owns engineering/evidence content. Git mirrors exact row values for typed implementation, validation and review; physical claims remain at their recorded evidence ceiling.

records.Name: CGX volumetric field twin
records.Role: Replace flat schematic-only representation with spatial + temporal component/material/field state
records.Coordinates / State: x,y,z,t; frequency is transform/view of t
records.Safety / Hard Gate: no field may be treated as measured without evidence
records.CGX Output: filespace geometry + dataspace state + solid-state twin
records.Notes: Use '4D MRI' as analogy only; frequency is not counted as an extra physical dimension.

records.Name: Global frame
records.Role: Common assembly datum for all nested components
records.Build / Assembly Use: register all parts/layers into one body

records.Name: Local component frame
records.Role: Stable child datum for each component archetype/instance
records.Build / Assembly Use: allows reuse/rotation/scaling only within qualified geometry
records.Safety / Hard Gate: no silent nonuniform scaling of functional devices

records.Name: Occupancy / signed-distance field
records.Role: Represent solid/free-space boundary independent of mesh

records.Name: Material identity field
records.Role: Assign every occupied region to material/passport lot

records.Name: Void / cavity field
records.Role: Track intentionally empty, gas, vacuum or fluid-filled regions
records.Safety / Hard Gate: void is never an energy source

records.Name: Semiconductor process field
records.Build / Assembly Use: seed die twin; future fabrication research
records.Safety / Hard Gate: never infer proprietary die geometry from package

records.Name: Electric field
records.Measurement / Calibration: field probe or inferred from validated model

records.Name: Damage / health field
records.Role: Spatially track accumulated damage and local margin
records.Field / Property: damage index; fatigue; corrosion; dose; cycles
records.Safety / Hard Gate: never use one scalar to hide hard failure

records.Name: Uncertainty field
records.Role: Attach uncertainty to every modeled/measured field

records.Name: Latitudinal / transverse slice
records.Safety / Hard Gate: same evidence ceiling as source fields

records.Name: Orthogonal depth slice
records.Safety / Hard Gate: no interpolation beyond resolution without flag

records.Name: Cylindrical/radial unwrap
records.Role: Inspect coils, coax, pipes, bearings and cylindrical devices

records.Name: Interface-normal slice
records.Role: Resolve thin boundary layers and contacts

records.Name: Spectral transform
records.Source / Authority: derived from time or harmonic model
records.Safety / Hard Gate: frequency is transform of time, not extra dimension

records.Name: Eigenmode / resonance map
records.Role: Find natural modes without assuming benefit
records.Safety / Hard Gate: no 'natural/user harmony' claim absent defined measurable target

records.Name: Phase/coherence map
records.Role: Track relative phase and coupling across embedded functions
records.Safety / Hard Gate: phase alignment is functional only when objective defined

records.Name: Micro-in-macro nested view
records.Role: Retain local fine geometry inside coarse body model
records.Build / Assembly Use: micro stacks embedded in macro structure
records.Safety / Hard Gate: homogenization cannot erase hot spots/failure modes

records.Name: Macro-in-micro boundary backfeed
records.Role: Feed system loads/environment into fine component region
records.Safety / Hard Gate: do not apply invalid uniform BC

records.Name: Multi-field overlap map
records.Build / Assembly Use: embedding, routing, shielding, thermal and sensor placement
records.Safety / Hard Gate: no single composite score can override hard safety/material gates

records.Name: Parasitic extraction map
records.Role: Derive unintended R/L/C/thermal/mechanical coupling from 3D layout
records.Field / Property: mutual L/C/R; thermal R; transfer functions
records.Build / Assembly Use: convert flat schematic into geometry-aware network

records.Name: Keep-out / incompatibility field
records.Field / Property: clearance; thermal budget; contamination; service access

records.Name: Spatially separated redundancy map
records.Role: Avoid common-mode failure while retaining duplicated function
records.Safety / Hard Gate: redundancy invalid if common cause not modeled

records.Name: Build-order state field
records.Role: Track what exists and future process exposure at each time
records.Field / Property: material state; cure/sinter; future thermal/chemical budget
records.Safety / Hard Gate: later step cannot silently damage prior component

records.Name: Printer-resolution envelope
records.Role: Prevent candidate geometries below current machine capability
records.Field / Property: min feature; layer; placement; registration; roughness

records.Name: Measurable exposure compatibility field
records.Role: Map only physically measurable human/environment interactions
records.Field / Property: EM field; acoustic SPL; vibration; temperature; surface chemistry/contaminant
records.Safety / Hard Gate: no biological 'resonance harmony' inference without empirical protocol

records.Name: Slice-to-print compiler contract
records.Role: Turn validated volumetric state into manufacturable layered operations
records.Safety / Hard Gate: candidate functions remain bounded by evidence and tool capability
